podcast.body: In 1994, Geffen Records issued this B-side track for free on Compuserve, which was the dominant internet service provider at the time. This marked the first ever major label distribution of a song over the internet. Due to dial-up modem speeds of the era, downloading the four-and-a-half-minute track took approximately 90 minutes. It was distributed as a wave file in fairly low fidelity, serving as an early "beta test" for digital music distribution.
